wa_orange_sunshine_area_thearetical.notes: DUPLICATE QUESTION (batch U): not settled by a publisher, reported either way. No source lists a route named 'Thearetical': Mountain Project's Orange Sunshine area (25 routes) and Main Face lists lack it, and two web searches (also 'The Aretical' / 'Theoretical') found nothing. The only match is wa_the_arete_acal (The Arete-Acal, Main Face, sport 5.10a, 90 ft, 12 bolts, FA Kertzman 1994, extended by Fitz/Russell 2011): same grade, same style, and the name is a respelling of the same pun. Most likely a stray copy of that route filed under the wrong sub-area (catalog defect, both ids: wa_orange_sunshine_area_thearetical / wa_the_arete_acal), but no source confirms it, so nothing is merged and no route facts are proposed. Pitches stays null (already not 0). Access/permit proposed only because the whole Royal Columns crag is the same WDFW land; drop them if the owner retires the row.
